fuse_notes.CKDIV8: LFUSE bit 7; programmed means divide the system clock by eight.
fuse_notes.CKOUT: LFUSE bit 6; programmed routes the system clock to PB4/CLKO.
fuse_notes.SUT: LFUSE bits 5:4; startup delay, interpreted with the selected clock source.
fuse_notes.RSTDISBL: HFUSE bit 7; programmed disables RESET and requires high-voltage serial programming for recovery.
fuse_notes.SPIEN: HFUSE bit 5; programmed enables serial programming and is not writable through SPI ISP.
fuse_notes.WDTON: HFUSE bit 4; programmed forces watchdog-always-on behavior.
fuse_notes.EESAVE: HFUSE bit 3; programmed preserves EEPROM through chip erase.
fuse_notes.BODLEVEL: HFUSE bits 2:0; 111 disabled, 110 1.8 V, 101 2.7 V, 100 4.3 V.
fuse_notes.SELFPRGEN: EFUSE bit 0; programmed enables flash self-programming. EFUSE bits 7:1 must remain 1.

lock_modes.0xFF: Mode 1: no memory lock features enabled.
lock_modes.0xFE: Mode 2: further flash/EEPROM programming disabled and fuses locked.
lock_modes.0xFC: Mode 3: further flash/EEPROM programming and verification disabled and fuses locked.

internal_pll_16mhz_5v_bod43_preserve.hardware: no crystal; regulated supply and local decoupling

external_crystal_10mhz.hardware: crystal on PB3/PB4 plus calculated load capacitors

external_crystal_16mhz.hardware: crystal on PB3/PB4 plus calculated load capacitors

external_crystal_20mhz.hardware: crystal on PB3/PB4 plus calculated load capacitors
